en.text:
Kills scored by abilities and other guns grant stacks of 'Worm's Hunger'. Maximum of 20 stacks.

Stacks earned based on <link Combatant Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Tier 1 and 2: 1 stack
• Tier 3 and 4: 4 stacks
• Minibosses, Bosses, and Players: 5 stacks

Worm's Hunger grants 10% increased damage and ?% increased Blast Radius for each stack, up to a maximum of 200% increased damage and ?% larger Blast Radius.
